prompt:
The section sections/social-feed-section.liquid shows a social media feed. It has a heading and an account handle that links to the profile. The link opens in a new tab when section.settings.open_in_new_tab is true. It also shows a list of post blocks; the markup escapes each post's caption both as text and inside the link's title attribute. The current schema is wrong in three ways: caption is a single-line text field, the open_in_new_tab setting is missing, and there is no block limit.

Do not change the markup. Replace only the JSON inside the single {% schema %} block so that it is exactly the following, with keys and array items in this order:
- "name": "Social feed"
- "tag": "section"
- "class": "section-social-feed"
- "settings", in this order:
  1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Follow us"
  2. type "text", id "handle", label "Account handle", default "@ourstore"
  3. type "url", id "profile_url", label "Profile link" (no default key)
  4. type "checkbox", id "open_in_new_tab", label "Open profile in new tab", default true (a JSON boolean)
- "blocks": one block type, with type "post" and name "Post". Its settings, in this order:
  1. type "textarea", id "caption", label "Caption", default "Fresh drops & behind-the-scenes <3". The default must contain the literal characters & and < exactly as written; the markup escapes them.
  2. type "url", id "link", label "Post link" (no default key)
- "max_blocks": 8 (a number)
- "presets": one preset with name "Social feed" and blocks set to exactly two entries, each {"type": "post"}.
Add no other keys. Change only sections/social-feed-section.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
